title: 立场：AI尚不适合战略冲突
summary: 该立场论文指出，基于语言模型的开放式兵棋推演存在决策洗白、裁决不透明、角色崩塌、裁决升级和战略想象力缺失五大失效模式，认为在缺乏可审计安全论证前，不应将LM兵棋用于规划、条令、政策或危机应对，其当前正确用途是压力测试影响决策的LM智能体。
summary_en: This position paper argues that no LM-enabled wargame should inform planning, doctrine, policy, or crisis response without an auditable safety case. It identifies five failure modes: decision laundering, adjudication opacity, role collapse, escalation-through-adjudication, and failure of strategic imagination, concluding that open-ended wargames should serve as stress tests for decision-influencing LM agents rather than safety cases.
